title: Reading Nature: Urban Green Space and Public Attention
prompt: In many cities, access to parks, trees and other natural spaces is unevenly distributed, and some planners argue that improving this access is mainly an environmental issue rather than a social one. To what extent do you agree or disagree with the view that providing urban green space should be treated primarily as a social priority rather than an environmental one? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先明确题目要求你在多大程度上同意或不同意“城市绿地应主要被视为社会优先事项，而非环境优先事项”这一观点。写作时需清楚表明自己的立场，并在全文中保持一致；每个主体段提出一个理由，用具体例子或推理加以展开，避免只罗列观点。注意讨论“社会优先”与“环境优先”之间的张力，而不是单纯描述绿地的好处。建议用约5分钟规划结构，40分钟完成写作，写完后检查是否达到250词、是否回应了题目的比较性要求。
